description: Build a playable performance panel (a Container COMP of visual widgets) for live use, beyond the parameter dialog: vertical faders that drive parameters, and buttons that recall or morph to named cues (from manage_cue). Open the container in Perform/Panel mode for a touchable surface — faders move their parameters, cue buttons fire scenes (instantly or with a crossfade).

align.description: How the panel lays out its widgets.

comp_path.description: Control COMP that holds the cues (manage_cue) and custom params. The surface is built inside it and its buttons fire that COMP's cues.

cue_buttons.description: Buttons that recall or morph to named cues.

cue.description: Name of a cue (stored with manage_cue) to fire.

label.description: Text shown on the button; defaults to the cue name.

morph_seconds.description: 0 = jump instantly to the cue; >0 = crossfade over this many seconds.

faders.description: Vertical faders, each driving a parameter.

label.description: Text shown above the fader; defaults to no label.

max.description: Value at the top of the fader.

min.description: Value at the bottom of the fader.

param.description: Parameter the fader drives, written as 'nodePath.parName'.

name.description: Name of the panel container to build.

name: create_control_surface
title: Create control surface
